svg.text: AIGEN Phase 2 — Run Time (Azure Data Plane)
triggered by data arriving · executes Phase 1 generated code · no AI active · no manifest inference · no code generation
ZONE 1 — REAL DATA ARRIVES (triggers the deployed adapters · all generated by Phase 1)
Example — raw Event Hubs (Kafka) message received by the adapter:
ZONE 2 — FEDERATED ADAPTERS (Runs Python Parser Models · Hosted on Databricks/AKS/Functions)
ZONE 3 — CANONICAL ENVELOPE (Enforced via Python Models & Azure Schema Registry)
Every adapter outputs this identical envelope — transformation sees only this, never the raw format
A CSV row, an API JSON response, and a Kafka event all become this same structure before transformation runs
ZONE 4 — TRANSFORMATION ENGINE (runs Phase 1 generated code · no AI · no manifest)
Applies native Python transform ML models
Checkpoints state to Azure ADLS Gen 2
Azure Data Factory Pipeline Scheduled Trigger
Applies complex Python rules & logic models
Synapse SQL pushes for in-warehouse joins
Output — what the generated PySpark code does to the canonical envelope:
df.withColumn("items", explode("payload.items")) # flatten array -> 2 rows for order A123
ZONE 6 — OUTPUT SINKS (defined in manifest · configured by Phase 1 generated code)
Output — rows written to Synapse orders_clean table (2 rows from 1 Kafka message):
{"id":"A123", "sky":"X2", "qty":1, "ts":"2024-01-15T10:30:00Z", "status":"ACTIVE" } → items[] exploded directly to 2 tabular rows
publish pipeline_complete event to Service Bus
alerts: lag · DLQ backlog · job failure
When does Phase 2 pause and Phase 1 re-run?
Format change • new source/sink • transformation rule change • schema version bump → re-run Phase 1 • redeploy • Phase 2 resumes
More data arriving • volume increase • same format → Phase 2 continues completely dynamically • Phase 1 is never involved
Phase 2 contains: no manifest files • no Azure OpenAI calls • no code generators • no AI core
It only executes code that Phase 1 already wrote and Azure DevOps CI/CD already deployed.
